title: Dyadic Analysis Filter Bank
text: Decompose signals into subbands with smaller bandwidths and slower sample rates or compute discrete wavelet transform (DWT), 1 input, 1 output, no direct feedthrough, {Filter} sets Type of filter used in subband decomposition; {Filter order [synthesis / analysis]} sets the analysis and synthesis filter orders for biorthogonal filters, {Wavelet order} sets the order for orthogonal wavelets, {Lowpass FIR filter coefficients}, {Highpass FIR filter coefficients}, {Number of levels} sets the number of filter bank levels used, {Tree structure} sets the structure of filter and {Output} sets the single port or multiple ports Multiple. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: Output 1
ports.summary: Dyadic subband decomposition output column vector | matrix

params.name: Filter
params.values: Type of filter used in subband decomposition User-defined (default) | Haar | Daubechies | Symlets | Coiflets | Biorthogonal | Reverse Biorthogonal | Discrete Meyer

params.name: Filter order [synthesis / analysis]
params.values: Analysis and synthesis filter orders for biorthogonal filters [1 / 1] (default) | [1 / 3] | [1 / 5] | [2 / 2] | [2 / 4] | [2 / 6] | [2 / 8] | [3 / 1] | [3 / 3] | [3 / 5] | [3 / 7] | [3 / 9] | [4 / 4] | [5 / 5] | [6 / 8]

params.name: Wavelet order
params.values: Order for orthogonal wavelets 2 (default) | positive integer

params.name: Lowpass FIR filter coefficients
params.values: Lowpass FIR filter coefficients [0.0352 -0.0854 -0.1350 0.4599 0.8069 0.3327] (default) | row vector

params.name: Highpass FIR filter coefficients
params.values: Highpass FIR filter coefficients [-0.3327 0.8069 -0.4599 -0.1350 0.0854 0.0352] (default) | row vector

params.name: Number of levels
params.values: Number of filter bank levels used in analysis (decomposition) 2 (default) | integer greater than or equal to 1

params.name: Tree structure
params.values: Structure of filter bank Asymmetric (default) | Symmetric

params.name: Output
params.values: Single port or multiple ports Multiple ports (default) | Single port
